Historical precipitation near Sisters, Oregon

Source: R/data.R
sisters_precip_historical.Rd

Gridded daily precipitation for the same point and pull as sisters_air_temp_historical, partitioned into rain and snow. Not a model predictor — snowmelt timing reaches summer stream temperature through discharge, which the model already observes directly at Camp Polk.

Usage

sisters_precip_historical

Format

A data frame with columns:

date

Date. Observation date.

precip_mm

Numeric. Total daily precipitation in millimetres.

rain_mm

Numeric. Precipitation falling on days with mean air temperature above 0 degrees Celsius.

snow_mm

Numeric. Precipitation falling on days with mean air temperature at or below 0 degrees Celsius.

Source

GridMET (~4 km gridded surface meteorology), variable pr, pulled with climateR::getGridMET().

Details

The rain/snow split is a simple temperature threshold, not a physical partition: precipitation is classed as snow when the day's mean air temperature is at or below 0 degrees Celsius and as rain otherwise, so rain_mm and snow_mm always sum to precip_mm.
